description: The handoff success line 'Handed off to Setup agent · agent · In progress.' stays under the Status row after the agent handed the task back and after Priya set it to Completed, contradicting the current state.
expected: Success feedback is transient, or clears when the task's assignee or status changes.
actual: The stale line is still shown beside 'Status: Completed'.
suggested_fix: Clear the handoff status message on the next task change (or after a timeout), like other success toasts.

description: Delegating to 'my agent' means choosing between two identical 'Setup agent · agent' recipients (Priya's and Marcus's). The correct one could only be found by reading DOM option values.
expected: Recipients are distinguishable, e.g. 'Setup agent (you)' or 'Setup agent · Priya Raman'.
actual: Two identical options. Same root cause as F-090-02 / F-091-01.
suggested_fix: Qualify agent display names with their sponsoring human, and mark your own agent.

description: Evidence renders the commit message with subject and body joined on one line ('Add idempotency keys to POST /payments Reuse request_id header.').
expected: The subject as a title line, and the body separate or collapsed behind 'more'.
actual: Newlines collapsed into a single sentence.
suggested_fix: Split commit messages on the first blank line and render the subject and body separately.
